subject: general
question: Ustad Bismillah Khan is best known for playing which of the following instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shehnai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Bismillah**

 
 
• **Shehnai** used to be played by **Ustad Bismillah Khan**.
 
• Indian artist **Ustad Bismillah Khan, whose real name was Qamaruddin Khan (lived from 1916 to 2006) is credited for making the Shehnai popular**.
 
• The musical instrument shehnai is **comparable to the oboe (common in India, Pakistan, and Bangladesh)**.
 
• He received various honours, such as;
 
 
• **Padma Shri in 1961 **
 
• **Padma Bhushan in 1968 **
 
• **Padma Vibhushan in 1980 **
 
• **Bharat Ratna in 2001**
 
 
 
• At the **first Republic Day event in 1950**, he also performed the Shehnai.
 
• **Google honoured** him with a **Google doodle on the occasion of his 102nd birthday**.
